Stable mutable tuples represent borrowed HTMLAttr** slots; the original table field order and retained shared table identity are preserved. OSL_ENSURE diagnostics do not become new runtime failures. Source-contract tests only; complete Writer/compiled native parity remains unverified. Native NewAttr/DeleteAttr/SaveAttrTab borrow actual parser fields, preserve chain admission/deletion/pending queues and rebind only open owners when moving tables. Native EndAttr preserves empty-range admission, Latin/CJK/CTL script splits, previous-chain retention, front/back queue priority, middle/head correction and source return semantics. Its borrowed script producer is the existing i18npool BreakIteratorImpl; native SwBreakIt service wiring remains part of unfinished HTMLReader composition. Only the zero/end-offset GoInContent boundary branch is consumed here, through source checked GoPos admission and endpoint assignment; general character movement/SwPaM.Move is not claimed. Existing SwNodeIndex identity wrappers retain no separate registered content-index destructor. The actual parser supplies BreakIteratorImpl and consumes the existing queue through SetAttr_; previous whole HTMLReader/GC-only notes are superseded for these consumed branches. Full desktop parser composition and unsupported producers remain unverified. S3HW1E connects actual ID and no-HREF named targets to native queued point bookmarks. Filter-private RES_FLTR_BOOKMARK is174, with no document pool default. Actual HTMLAttr can retain a null table for unheaded queued marks; SetAttr_ uses exact original name/position deduplication, raw offset clamping and real DocumentMarkAccess name allocation. HTML ID/font/style consumers retain source option order. Native implicit target separator and Unambiguous decode selection preserve encoded name spelling; WRITER221 documents queue-boundary naming. Actual parser/Markdown/Worker/RTF tests cover this profile; language/direction/section/HREF and full filter parity remain open.
